item.text: The discovery flow already carries SQL Server’s protocol through routing; the missing pieces are the pinger and protocol dispatch. The repo has the SQL Server driver and connector already in use, so I’m building the diagnostic with that connector, propagating the caller’s context, and categorizing the driver’s usual refusal, login, and database errors.
